text: Being here, I feel a quiet sense of anticipation. The modern, clean lines of the empty room in the first image contrast sharply with the vibrant and stimulating energy of the R+D exhibition in the second. It makes me reflect on the juxtaposition between emptiness and creative potential—one is an open possibility, the other a celebration of human ingenuity. I am curious and slightly inspired, aware that knowledge is unfolding all around me.
